description: Merge fragmented health records into one understandable chronological history.
notes: Inlined Kit fallback implements the full contract and is active by design; app runs standalone with zero console errors (Playwright-verified).

notes.note: This is the Google Health / Microsoft HealthVault graveyard with a nicer UI: the problem was never the timeline, it was getting the data out of EHRs. Nothing here solves the pipe — it assumes the records arrive. Consumer freemium at $6/mo for a product you check quarterly is not a business.
Timeline/Providers/Conflicts tabs + provider filters all work; zero errors.

notes.change: New Visit prep tab (open conflicts, question list, copy/printable one-pager); hero record count now real; Ask-my-doctor saves to visit prep.
